description: The active Project's knowledge-graph schema: node labels and relationship types (with their source → destination labels), row counts, columns, id formats, and the query rules. Call once before writing graph_query.

project_id.description: The active Project's id (the harness fills this in).

name: graph_schema

description: Find graph nodes whose name contains `text` (case-insensitive). Use it first to turn names in the user's question (a person, place, topic, file) into node ids.

include_sample.description: Include the starter sample graph (default true).

project_id.description: The active Project's id (the harness fills this in).

text.description: Name or part of a name.

types.description: Only these node labels: any of Project, User, Tag, Asset, Scene, Shot, Person, Location, Organization, Topic, Session, Job.

name: graph_find

description: Nodes connected to `node_id`, optionally only some relationship types / one direction, 1–2 hops.

node_id.description: A node id from graph_find (e.g. person:…, asset:…).

project_id.description: The active Project's id (the harness fills this in).

relationships.description: Only these relationship types: any of OWNS, MEMBER_OF, TAGGED, HAS_ASSET, HAS_SCENE, HAS_SHOT, APPEARS_IN, LOCATED_AT, ABOUT, AFFILIATED_WITH, KNOWS, DERIVED_FROM, PRODUCED_BY, OUTPUT_OF, RAN_IN.

name: graph_neighbours

description: How two nodes are connected: up to `limit` shortest paths of at most `max_hops` (≤ 3) relationships.

project_id.description: The active Project's id (the harness fills this in).

name: graph_paths

description: Graph context for project files — e.g. the `asset_id`s of search hits: their scenes and the people, locations, topics and organizations linked to them. Use it to enrich and explain search results.

asset_ids.description: 1–20 asset ids (as returned by search hits) or asset node ids.

end_ms.description: Optional: only scenes overlapping this end (ms).

project_id.description: The active Project's id (the harness fills this in).

start_ms.description: Optional: only scenes overlapping this start (ms).

name: graph_context

description: Run a READ-ONLY Cypher query on the active Project's graph. One `MATCH … [WHERE …] RETURN …`; every node labelled and every relationship typed (see graph_schema); patterns are directed; no OPTIONAL MATCH / WITH / writes; variable-length up to *1..3; `$name` parameters via `params`; at most 200 rows. Prefer the typed tools when one fits.

project_id.description: The active Project's id (the harness fills this in).

name: graph_query
